[打开三顶点投影练习](../index.html#classroom/foun: [Open the three-vertex projection exercise](../index.html#classroom/foundations?module=demos&experiment=projection&preset=triangle-permutation) and check the reduction using the same basis functions. Align the columns by operation. The D₃ order is identity, threefold rotation, and twofold rotation, with characters (3, 0, 1). Projecting the three basis functions gives ranks 1, 0, and 2 for A₁, A₂, and E. The symmetric sum projects to zero in E, while each individual vertex function has a nonzero E projection. [MIT notes on the projection formula](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/res-18-011-algebra-i-student-notes-fall-2021/pages/student-notes/)
在[双空间群螺旋课](../index.html#classroom/cryst: Run the twofold screw demonstration in the [double-space-group lesson](../index.html#classroom/crystal?track=double&lesson=double-06), then carry the current axial wavevector into the double-valued workbench for space group 4. Find the operation about z with translation (0, 0, ½). Manually calculate the two one-dimensional little-group representations and compare the characters of that operation. They are ±i at Γ and ±1 at k_z=½. [IUCr definition of a screw operation](https://www.iucr.org/who-we-are/commissions/commission-on-crystallographic-nomenclature/published-reports/symsym)
